# Sidharth Kapoor — Web3 Engineer

Canonical website: https://www.sidk.dev/

Sidharth Kapoor is a Web3 Engineer at IQ Industries who builds smart contracts and backend infrastructure for onchain markets. He has more than four years of experience across token launches, prediction markets, stablecoin infrastructure, blockchain indexers, relayers, backend APIs, and production services around smart contracts.

## Current role

- Employer: IQ Industries
- Title: Web3 Engineer
- Period: 2023–present
- Employer website: https://iqindustries.com/

## Experience highlights

- Contributed to smart contracts and backend infrastructure for IQ AI's agentic tokenization launchpad.
- Supported more than $2 million in total value locked across bonding-curve token launches, liquidity migration, and blockchain event indexing.
- Worked on white-label prediction-market infrastructure on Polygon using Gnosis Conditional Tokens, oracle integrations, EIP-712 signatures, gasless relayers, and onchain settlement.
- Supported testing and deployment workflows for KRWQ stablecoin infrastructure, including deployment verification, contract interaction testing, and release checks.
- Wrote Foundry fork, fuzz, and integration tests across protocol flows, with security-focused review around production deployments.

## Technical capabilities

- Solidity and smart contract engineering
- Foundry testing, including fork tests, fuzz tests, and invariant tests
- DeFi and protocol integrations
- Blockchain indexers
- Backend APIs and production services
- Relayer infrastructure and EIP-712 flows
- Security tooling and deployment verification
- Prediction-market and stablecoin infrastructure

## Selected projects

### perp-margin-engine

A minimal perpetuals margin engine covering collateral accounting, long and short positions, profit and loss, liquidations, and bad-debt handling. Its test suite includes fuzz and invariant coverage around critical protocol behavior.

- Source: https://github.com/SidharthK2/perp-margin-engine
- Technologies: Solidity, Foundry, liquidations, invariant testing

### IQ Lend

A leveraged lending prototype for IQ using Morpho Blue-style primitives, flash-loan-assisted positions, and time-weighted average pricing sourced from onchain Fraxswap liquidity.

- Demo: https://iq-lend-ui.vercel.app/
- Source: https://github.com/SidharthK2/iq-lend
- Technologies: Solidity, Foundry, Morpho Blue, Curve, Fraxswap
